office_does: Grant PUD's five elected commissioners set policy, review operations and approve the budget for the county's public electric and fiber-broadband utility, which owns the Priest Rapids and Wanapum dams.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Larry Schaapman, board president and a Quincy-area farmer, is the only candidate for the six-year District 3 term; the whole county votes.

candidates.summary: Grant PUD commissioner since a 2012 appointment and current board president; owns and manages a family farm near Quincy. The only candidate on the ballot; no voters'-guide statement.
highlights: Appointed in 2012, elected in 2013, re-elected unopposed in 2020 [S2][S4]
Board president; Quincy-area farmer on the Potato Growers of Washington board [S2]
